text:
Maya P: quick thought from research - users liked a very low-contrast progress cue that doesn't steal attention. thinking 'glimpse' instead of pulses/dots.
Tariq: what's a glimpse? a single pixel flash? animation cost?
Maya P: small left-edge fade (4px) that lights up on chunk flush then fades in 80ms. call it 'glimpse' in spec. not shown in docs to users.
Devon: easy to emit from stream events: add `glimpse:true` on chunk events. client computes tokens/sec for tiny sparkline if desired.
Lia (design): UX: show a compact token-rail to the right of each bubble in compact mode: shows used/~est and a tiny, static sparkline precomputed from chunk timings. clicking rail expands prompt caddy (pin + quick insert).
Maya P: microcopy: label that expands from rail = "Prompt caddy" (not library). helps avoid confusion with full library. actions: "Insert", "Pin", "Preview".
a11y-bot: a11y notes: 1) make glimpse disabled for `prefers-reduced-motion`, 2) token-rail must have alt text "Tokens used X, estimated remaining Y", 3) prompt caddy must be keyboard reachable and announce as a region.
Devon: dev notes: stream payload fields behind flag `playground_glimpse_v1`: `glimpse:bool`, `chunk_id:int`, `remaining_tokens_est:int`. token sparkline computed client-side. prompt caddy is purely frontend.
Maya P: copy test plan: 6 engineers for Prompt caddy language and Insert vs Quick-insert phrasing. Also test whether users understand the sparkline without legend.
Lia (design): I'll update frames and push to Figma: https://redwood.design/figma/playground/glimpse-caddy (frames 3-6).
Maya P: target sandbox rollout next sprint. Ping me for microcopy sign-off.
deploy-bot: sandbox build 2026-08-09T12:04:01 deployed (featureflag: playground_glimpse_v1).
